# Benchmark progress

**Status as of:** Phase 22. Generated from [classical-constants.toml](classical-constants.toml) (50 fixed irrational constants) and [arithmetic-families.toml](arithmetic-families.toml) (25 arithmetic families). See [research-objectives.md](../research-objectives.md) and [SCHEMA.md](SCHEMA.md).

**Evidence legend.** `lean` = Kernel-verified · `lean+paper` = Lean-supported paper proof · `paper` = Paper proof · `external` = External input · `open` = Open.

## Summary by objective (50 fixed constants)

Objective counts overlap (for example, *E*<sub>2</sub> is simply normal, proved nonnormal, and in *K*<sub>2</sub>) and do not sum to 50.

| Objective | Count / 50 | Criterion |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| Objective 1 (Establish normality / simple normality) | 5 | `full_normality = proved_normal` or `simple_normality = proved_simply_normal` |
| Objective 2 (Establish nonnormality) | 10 | `proved_nonnormal`, `proved_not_simply_normal`, `proved_non_disjunctive`, or `maximal_K_b` |
| Objective 3 (Quantify digit distribution) | 14 | `discrepancy_status` other than `open` |
| Objective 4 (Rigorous mathematical limitations) | 16 | `barrier_status = barrier_proved` |
| All four distributional fields open | 35 | `full_normality`, `simple_normality`, `disjunctivity`, `discrepancy_status` all `open` |
